info.title: DegenFeed API
info.description:
The DegenFeed API provides a unified interface to the decentralized social graph. It aggregates content from 25+ protocols (Nostr, Farcaster, Lens, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, RSS, Lemmy, PeerTube, YouTube, and more) into a single feed pipeline with cross-protocol identities, tipping, publishing, and engagement.

## Key Concepts

- **Unified Feed** — A single API that blends content from every connected network into ranked, personalized timelines.
- **Cross-Protocol Identities** — Link your wallet or accounts across Nostr, Farcaster, Lens, Bluesky, Mastodon, and more under a single identity.
- **Federated Search** — Search across all protocols in parallel with deduplication and relevance ranking.
- **Engagement** — Like, repost, reply, and bookmark content on any protocol from a single API.
- **Publishing** — Cross-post to multiple protocols simultaneously.
- **Tipping** — Send crypto tips across chains (Base, Solana, Ethereum, Lightning) to any creator.

## Authentication

DegenFeed uses three authentication methods:

1. **Session Cookie** (`__Host-dfid`) — Set after wallet or email login. Used for browser-based requests. Requires `X-CSRF-Token` header for state-changing operations.
2. **API Key** (`X-API-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`) — For server-to-server integration. Scoped to specific resource groups (`read:feed`, `write:publish`, etc.).
3. **Wallet Signature** — EIP-4361 (Ethereum) or Solana wallet signature for direct wallet auth without a session.

## Base URLs

All API endpoints are available under `/api/` (legacy, with deprecation headers) and `/v1/` (stable, versioned). New integrations should use `/v1/`.

walletParam.name: wallet
walletParam.description: Wallet address for personalization (optional — anonymous requests get trending fallback)

limitParam.name: limit
limitParam.description: Maximum number of results to return (max 200)

cursorParam.name: cursor
cursorParam.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results

sessionCookie.name: __Host-dfid
sessionCookie.description: Session cookie set after wallet/email authentication. For state-changing requests (POST/PUT/DELETE), also provide `X-CSRF-Token` header matching the session.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: API key for server-to-server integration. Alternatively, use `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Generate keys via `POST /v1/api-keys`.

walletSignature.description: Direct wallet authentication via EIP-4361 (Ethereum) or Solana signed message. Used in combination with `POST /v1/auth/wallet/nonce` and `POST /v1/auth/wallet/verify`.

UnifiedIdentity.description: Cross-protocol identity object normalizing a user's presence across all connected networks.

handles.description: Handles per protocol (null if not linked)

Embed.description: Embedded media or link within a post.

EngagementVector.description: Viewer-specific engagement state for a post.

FeedDebug.description: Transparency debug data explaining why a post appeared in a feed.

UnifiedPost.description: The core post object normalizing content from any protocol into a unified shape.

rootId.description: Root post ID for thread tracking

crossPostedTo.description: Protocols this post was also cross-posted to

dfUri.description: Universal df:// URI for cross-protocol addressing

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Absent when no more results.

FeedResponse.description: Paginated feed response with an array of unified posts.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response for all API endpoints.

additionalProperties.description: Protocol-specific identity data keyed by protocol name

cached.description: Whether the response was served from cache

get.summary: Get unified feed from all protocols
get.description: Returns a blended feed of content from ALL connected protocols (Nostr, Farcaster, Lens, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, RSS, etc.). Content is ranked by relevance, recency, and engagement velocity. Supports cursor-based pagination and filtering by source, protocol, and category.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: Comma-separated feed source keys to include (e.g. 'activitypub,nostr,farcaster')

parameters.name: protocols
parameters.description: Comma-separated protocol names to filter by

200.description: Unified feed with posts and pagination metadata

get.description: Returns a personalized feed based on the user's wallet address. Uses behavior profiles (likes, reposts, dwell time, follows) to curate content. Falls back to trending content for anonymous users.

note.description: Note when falling back to trending for anonymous users

get.summary: Get home feed with protocol sections
get.description: Returns the main home feed organized by protocol sections. Blends content from all supported protocols into a sectioned layout optimized for the home screen. Supports hot/trending/newest sort orders.

Searches ALL supported protocols in parallel (Nostr, Farcaster, Lens, Bluesky, Mastodon, Lemmy, PeerTube, RSS) plus the local MeiliSearch index. Results are deduplicated and ranked by relevance using a multi-factor scoring model (exact match +10, engagement up to +5, recency +3, verified +2).
Searches for identities (users/creators) across all connected protocols by display name or bio. Uses MeiliSearch local index with fallback to direct handle resolution.

get.summary: Resolve a handle to a protocol identity
get.description: Resolves a handle (e.g. 'vitalik.eth', 'npub1...', '@username') to a cross-protocol identity. Checks KV cache first (5-minute TTL) before performing resolution. Returns the resolved identity with all linked protocols.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle, address, or DID to resolve

post.summary: Link a protocol identity to your wallet
post.description: Links a protocol account (Nostr npub, Farcaster FID, Lens profile, Bluesky DID, etc.) to the authenticated wallet address. Requires a valid session. The linked identity appears in the user's cross-protocol profile.

delete.summary: Unlink a protocol identity from your wallet
delete.description: Removes a protocol link from the authenticated wallet's cross-protocol identity. Requires a valid session.

post.description: Generates a one-time nonce for wallet signature-based authentication. The nonce must be signed by the wallet and submitted to `POST /auth/wallet/verify`. Nonces expire after 5 minutes and are single-use (consumed on verify).

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Wallet address to generate nonce for

429.description: Rate limited (max 20 nonces per minute per IP)

post.summary: Verify wallet signature and create session
post.description: Verifies a signed message from the wallet and creates an authenticated session. Supports both Ethereum (EIP-4361 / personal_sign) and Solana (ed25519) signatures. On success, returns a `Set-Cookie` header with the session cookie (`__Host-dfid`) and an `X-CSRF-Token` header for subsequent state-changing requests.

message.description: The message that was signed (includes nonce)

200.description: Wallet verified, session created. Set-Cookie and X-CSRF-Token headers set.

X-CSRF-Token.description: CSRF token for subsequent state-changing requests

401.description: Invalid or expired nonce, or invalid signature

429.description: Rate limited (max 5 verifications per minute per address)

post.summary: Publish content to one or more protocols
post.description: Cross-posts content to multiple protocols simultaneously. Supports Postiz integration for premium users (Pro+ tier) with fallback to per-protocol publishing. Requires authentication and CSRF token. Rate limited to 30 publishes per minute.

results.description: Per-protocol publish results keyed by protocol name

via.description: Backend used ('postiz' or omitted for per-protocol)

403.description: Invalid CSRF token or Premium required

post.summary: Engage with a post (like, repost, reply, etc.)
post.description: Performs an engagement action (like, unlike, repost, unrepost, bookmark, unbookmark, reply, react) on a post across supported protocols. Requires authentication. Also tracks user behavior for personalization.

get.description: Returns aggregated notifications from all connected protocols (Nostr, Farcaster, Lens, Bluesky, Mastodon) plus internal DegenFeed notifications (tips, follows). Supports per-protocol auth tokens in the request body for fetching protocol-native notifications. Results are deduplicated, filtered by user preferences, and sorted newest-first.
Returns the current health status of the API, including Nostr relay connectivity, error counts, and overall service status. Lightweight endpoint suitable for monitoring and uptime checks.

get.summary: Get health status of all connected protocols
get.description: Returns detailed health data for every protocol DegenFeed connects to. Each protocol has a 3-tier status (up/degraded/down) based on health check results and circuit breaker state. Cached in KV for 30 seconds.

post.description: Launches a new creator coin via the cross-protocol coin management system. Supports Farcaster and Lens protocol coins. Requires authentication. The coin is registered across chains and can be tipped, traded, and collected.

post.summary: Send a tip to a creator
post.description: Sends a crypto tip to a creator across supported chains (Base, Solana, Ethereum, Lightning). Tips can be protocol-native or cross-chain via Wormhole bridge. Requires authentication.

get.description: Returns trending posts across all networks ranked by engagement velocity. Uses a multi-factor trending algorithm considering likes, reposts, replies, quote velocity, and time decay. Cached in KV for 5 minutes.

Returns suggested people/creators to follow based on cross-protocol engagement metrics, niche relevance, and verification status. Includes handles, avatar, bio, and protocol presence across all connected networks.

post.description: Initiates the account deletion process (GDPR-compliant). After requesting deletion, there is a 24-hour grace period during which the deletion can be cancelled via `POST /account/delete/cancel`. After the grace period, all associated data is permanently removed.

get.description: Executes a custom feed recipe and returns the blended results. Custom feeds are user-defined content pipelines with specific protocol sources, topic boost weights, content type filters, and minimum engagement thresholds.

Returns the daily newsletter digest content — a curated selection of top posts, trending topics, and notable activity from across all connected protocols. The digest is generated daily and cached for performance.
